scope: Convergence planning requested by user; no model/RTL/build/board execution authorized by this plan itself

decision.main: A: bounded screening of translation admission/service versus downstream DMA completion under the original fixed-destination workload
decision.backup: B: stage-dependent protection with existing feedback and switching costs fully retained; parked until an actual decision-changing phase trace exists

basis: A has a concrete existing phenomenon, so it receives one cheap evidence gate, not an assumed paper contribution. B has no accepted natural phase witness yet and old p1-p6 already adapt; neither generic feedback nor generic translation/data coupling is novel.
critical_sources: p1-p5 common V completion feedback; p6 gap feedback; distinguish billing from feedback
configuration requires quiet and legal configuration produces clear_o; no free online mode switching
DS-priority is a model-only legal read-return queue intervention, not board MIG implementation
synthetic CPU admission depends on its own completion; cannot assume equal background work at unequal endpoints
DS latency equal does not eliminate PN difference; extra closed-loop CPU requests are a confound, not proven sole cause

core_papers.read: §5.2–5.4, original text; fill tokens are not DMA source admission

core_papers.key: Scheduling Page Table Walks for Irregular GPU Applications
core_papers.read: SIMT completion batching, score and aging; not arbitrary cross-device group semantics

core_papers.key: Scalable and Efficient Virtual Memory Sharing in Heterogeneous SoCs with TLB Prefetching and MMU-Aware DMA Engine
core_papers.read: original abstract and design motivation; retry buffers and software/hardware contract must be charged

core_papers.key: KPart: A Hybrid Cache Partitioning-Sharing Technique for Commodity Multicores
core_papers.read: adaptive profiling and capacity/bandwidth effect; not IOMMU implementation

core_papers.key: Beyond the Bermuda Triangle of Contention: IOMMU Interference in Mixed Criticality Systems
core_papers.read: measured interference; §V-C mitigation discussion not full regulator evaluation

adjacent_checks.software: IOTLB Wall already covers hugepage-aware allocator; broad layout candidate closed
adjacent_checks.group_dependencies: mNPUsim and NeuMMU required if claiming task/slack semantics
adjacent_checks.latest_parallelism: cuPTW/NB-Walker required if design adds parallel walker/context/offload; paper/artifact evidence depth must stay explicit
adjacent_checks.cxl: SDM is Sharing-Enabled Disaggregated Memory System with Cache Coherent Compute Express Link, PACT 2023; related to sharing but not central to fixed-destination DMA screening

gates.work: One evidence card: legal fixed workload, one exact failing decision, independent baseline, likely missing state and a distinct prediction
gates.stop: Only broad PN slowdown, known queuing, a bug, or no new decision relative to documented Oct6/8 proposals

gates.work: Freeze baseline algorithms and calibration protocol before evaluating candidate; permit common information but do not insert full new rule
gates.stop: No difference from concrete same-cost ordinary credit/priority/prefetch/completion control

gates.work: At most six decisive model scenario groups; reuse existing outputs where unchanged; no full cross product
gates.stop: Difference relies on hidden admission waiting, biased CPU work, forbidden protocol action, cheap weakened baseline or uncharged storage/ports

gates.work: Freeze candidate and test two held-out conditions; same V/A work and release/dependency semantics, actual W/B completion
gates.stop: Only internal counter gain or no joint performance/cost usefulness; no retuning on held-out data

gates.work: One-page paper claim with scope, mechanism, difference, costs and adjacent failure before minimal RTL plan
gates.stop: No supported gap after at most two concrete design revisions

timing: Recommended cap 10 working days if execution is resumed; first route gate within one working day. Gates can terminate immediately; not a publication or duration promise.

review_acceptance.independent_reviewer: Recommended B before A. Accepted source corrections and baseline/switch-cost requirements; root chose A only for its existing evidence and bounded first gate, not expected novelty. B remains parked without a legal natural phase witness.
review_acceptance.deepseek: Historical navigation and five-paper extraction accepted as evidence aid. Some route-audit file:line references align with the supplement rather than the named report, and some suggested ideal controls are not executable baselines; neither is copied as authority.
review_acceptance.status: Critical route judgment and report are root-authored.
